mapper.select: SELECT q_code, keyword, response_msg, hit_count, use_yn, img_url FROM chatbot_quest ORDER BY q_code DESC -- 보통 최신순으로 정렬합니다.
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatbot_quest (q_code, keyword, response_msg, hit_count, use_yn, img_url) VALUES (SEQ_CHATBOT_QUEST.NEXTVAL, #{keyword}, #{response_msg}, 0, 'Y', #{img_url})
mapper.update: UPDATE chatbot_quest SET keyword = #{keyword}, response_msg = #{response_msg}, img_url = NVL(#{img_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, img_url) -- 새 이미지가 있으면 변경, 없으면 유지 WHERE q_code = #{q_code}
